headline: Fed Chair Warsh highlights strong *GDP* growth and investment
quote: The GDP increase in the first half of this year was revised
title: Fed Chair Warsh on Surprising GDP Growth and Capital Investment
caption: Fed Chair Kevin Warsh detailed stronger than expected economic expansion during the press conference. GDP growth for the first half of the year was revised upward to 2.4 percent, driven by robust high-tech investments.
comment: Do you think strong economic growth will force the Fed to hold interest rates higher for longer?
